rows.meaning: inactive; sitting most of the time
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a job or lifestyle involving little physical activity.

example.english: My job is really sedentary because I sit in the office all day.
example.traditional: 我份工成日坐喺辦公室，真係好少郁動。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fan6 gung1 seng4 jat6 co5 hai2 baan6 gung1 sat1 zan1 hai6 hou2 siu2 juk1 dung6

rows.note: Use this when something is staying still or not moving, especially in a physical context.

example.english: The bicycle stayed sedentary by the wall all night.
example.traditional: 架單車擺咗喺牆邊，成晚都唔郁。
example.jyutping: gaa3 daan1 ce1 baai2 zo2 hai2 coeng4 bin1 seng4 maan5 dou1 m4 juk1

rows.note: Use this for a person or population living permanently in one fixed place.

example.english: Their family has settled in Canada and now leads a sedentary life.
example.traditional: 佢哋一家已經喺加拿大定居咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 ji5 ging1 hai2 gaa1 naa4 daai6 ding6 geoi1 zo2
